name: gateway_display_resolve_display_setting
notes: Display setting resolution (LIVE gateway/display_config.py::resolve_display_setting vs traced copy of src/gateway/display_config.c::resolve_display_setting). Input '<platform>|<setting>|<fallback|->|<config_json>'. Ladder: display-obj guard, platform override walk (key/platforms/plat/val), global setting rung, fallback. KNOWN DIVERGENCES (documented): LIVE has legacy tool_progress_overrides and built-in _PLATFORM/_GLOBAL_DEFAULTS rungs the C port lacks; its normaliser maps tool_progress/bool-ish settings differently (inputs restricted to settings whose normalisers agree: grouping/reasoning/int/passthrough); unset cases use 'custom_flag' so LIVE falls through to fallback like C; a NULL/unparseable config crashes LIVE while C fails closed to fallback — such inputs were dropped.
